en-IN.name: CrewPay
en-IN.summary: Airline crew control that pays its crew: what is waiting for you, legal cover for a sick call, and whether you've been paid.
en-IN.description: CrewPay answers crew-control questions with legal, cost-ranked cover checked against duty-time rules, tells you what is waiting for your approval, and lets crew ask about their callout pay. A linked Echo chimes when something reaches you.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask crew pay what's waiting
Alexa, ask crew pay who covers T 1018
